replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I'm not a huge fan of the monuments, as they are really small and kinda plain and basic.

More structures could to added to the map to make it look more appealing.
The tree in the middle could use more to it, as well as better looking structures.

This map has some potential and I think its a really neat a idea, just fix it up a bit :)
As for YAML there are many people willing to make it for you! Contact me on Skype (thehoopsman) and I can help with it.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Very flat, small, basic, blocky, not exactly interesting. Blue team has a clear advantage by being in possesion of more diamond blocks, I can't really imagine a good gameplay, there's a very thin layer of blocks, there's no way to tunnel in this map, and the monument islands are just too small, there's not really a way to properly get to them.

I'm sorry but I'm gonna deny your map. Try working on improving what I've pointed out, I'm pretty sure you can achieve much better results in the future :)
